definitions.explanation: A hot pot dish featuring beef or pork intestines (もつ) simmered with cabbage, garlic chives, and other vegetables in a soy or miso-based broth. A specialty of Fukuoka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{福岡|ふくおか}→福岡：30729_fukuoka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧もつ{鍋|なべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
もつ{鍋|なべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ニラ→ニラ：11111_nira⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Garlic chives and cabbage are essential for motsunabe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧もつ{鍋|なべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: In winter, gathering around a pot of motsunabe with the family is something to look forward to.

notes:
もつ refers to internal organs (intestines, stomach, etc.), commonly written in hiragana on menus. The dish became a national boom in the 1990s and is now found across Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もつ{鍋|なべ}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: motsunabe restaurant
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧もつ{鍋|なべ}: soy-sauce-base motsunabe
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧もつ{鍋|なべ}: miso-base motsunabe
- もつ{鍋|なべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め→締め：16134_shime⟧: the finishing rice or noodles at the end of the pot
